latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of deepbook-cli skill: end-to-end DeepBook CLI operations.

- Supports market data retrieval, configuration, account management, spot and margin trading, swaps, balance management, and manager ops via deepbook CLI.
- Documents required installation, global config setup, and CLI global flags.
- Lists all available top-level and sub-commands, with argument/option cheat sheet for each operation.
- Details safety defaults for trading, manager compatibility, margin flows, dry-run, and internal fee buffer handling.
- Includes best-practice flows for end-to-end spot trading through a balance manager.
- Provides explicit guidance on global network/provider selection, key handling, and on-chain execution aliases.
